blocks.text: Inspired by the familiar experience of enduring the rainy season, the band uses changing weather as a metaphor for navigating the highs and lows of relationships. Filipino indie rock band the vowels they orbit (thevto) explores a nuanced but complex take on love, relationships, and emotional resilience with tila may pagtila, a four-track EP released under Sony Music Entertainment. Embedded in the Filipino expression of enduring heavy rains in the hope that they will eventually subside, the EP uses rain as a metaphor for emotional struggles, longing, and the determination to hold on to meaningful connections.
